question:
**Direction: Select the word from the options which is similar in meaning to the bracketed part given in the sentence below.**

I was **(feeling afraid)** that something bad would happen.
solution:
The correct answer is "Scared."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The phrase **"feeling afraid"** refers to the emotional state of experiencing fear or anxiety. (भय या चिंता का अनुभव करने की भावनात्मक स्थिति)

 
 
• Example: ***After hearing a strange noise outside her window, Emily lay in bed **feeling afraid**__.*
 
 
 
• The phrase "feeling afraid" can be replaced with "scared."
 
• The word "Scared" means frightened. (भयभीत)
 __
 
• Example:* I'm **scared**__ of telling her what really happened.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Sacred: **connected with God, a god or religion. (ईश्‍वर, किसी देवता या धर्म से संबंधित)
 
• **Divine: **connected with God or a god. (दिव्‍य, दैवी, ईश्‍वरीय)
 
• **Bold: **(used about a person or his/her behaviour) confident and not afraid. ((व्‍यक्ति या उसका व्‍यवहार) आत्‍मविश्‍वासी और निडर)
